primitives.name: BRCG Boolean Rule Classifier
primitives.verbatim_quote: BRCG rule learned: predict Y=1 iff [away last-year position > 3.00 AND head-to-head form > -1.02 AND home last-year position ≤ 10.00 AND home win% > 10.53], else 0.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'Y': 'binary outcome (1 = home win)', 'a_{ly}': 'away team last year position (dimensionless)', 'h2h': 'head-to-head form (dimensionless)', 'h_{ly}': 'home team last year position (dimensionless)', 'h_{win\\%}': 'home team win percentage (percent)'}
primitives.assumptions: Rule structure is deterministic; features are independent and ordered.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When any condition fails, prediction defaults to 0.

layer2.mapping: BRCG encodes a decision boundary in feature space equivalent to a disjunctive normal form of logical constraints, mapping to GSE's state transition logic.

primitives.name: Shapley Value Attribution
primitives.verbatim_quote: - Post-hoc: **Kernel SHAP** (Shapley values per feature, summed from a base value) evaluated with the **faithfulness** metric (correlation between SHAP importance and the attribute's effect on model performance); **ProtoDash** (5 training-set prototypes with importance weights nearest to each test instance).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\phi_i': 'Shapley value for feature i (dimensionless)', 'f(S)': 'model output given subset S of features', 'N': 'set of all features'}
primitives.assumptions: Model is additive; marginal contributions are symmetric and dummy-free.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When feature interactions exceed linear independence, attribution becomes ambiguous.

layer2.mapping: SHAP values provide a kernel-weighted contribution measure, enabling GSI to compute feature relevance under uncertainty.
layer2.telemetry: Faithfulness score (correlation between SHAP and actual impact).

primitives.name: Logistic Regression Coefficient Importance
primitives.verbatim_quote: Method / model - White-box: **BRCG-light** (Boolean rules via column generation with beam search; learns OR-of-ANDs classifiers) and **logistic regression** (weight magnitudes as feature importance) — both via IBM's **AIX360** library.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\hat{p}(Y=1)': 'predicted probability of home win (dimensionless)', '\\sigma': 'sigmoid function', '\\beta_i': 'regression coefficient for feature i (dimensionless)', 'x_i': 'feature value (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Linear relationship in logit space; features are normally distributed.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When non-linear effects dominate, coefficients misrepresent influence.

layer2.mapping: LogReg weights map to GSI’s Bayesian prior strength, enabling probabilistic outcome forecasting.
layer2.telemetry: Top features identified by magnitude of β.

reasoning_traces.think:
The BRCG classifier encodes a disjunctive normal form of logical constraints over team statistics, forming a decision boundary in feature space. It is structurally isomorphic to a set of propositional rules that define when a home win occurs. Logistic regression provides a differentiable, interpretable model where coefficients represent marginal impacts of features. These two models are dual in their interpretability: BRCG offers discrete, rule-based reasoning while LogReg offers continuous, gradient-driven inference. SHAP values bridge these by assigning each feature an additive contribution to the final prediction, effectively creating a kernel-based attribution mechanism. The faithfulness metric evaluates how well SHAP aligns with true feature impact, serving as a proxy for explanation quality. ProtoDash extends this by identifying nearest training instances, offering a geometric interpretation of local model behavior. Together, they form a triadic framework for explainable machine learning in sports analytics, where each primitive addresses distinct aspects of model transparency and reliability.
